segments.speaker: TIM
segments.en: Good morning. You’re through to the tourist information office, Tim speaking. How can I help you?

segments.speaker: JEAN
segments.en: Oh hello. Could you give me some information about next month’s festival, please? My family and I will be staying in the town that week.

segments.speaker: TIM
segments.en: Of course. Well it starts with a concert on the afternoon of the 17th.

segments.speaker: JEAN
segments.en: Oh I heard about that. The orchestra and singers come from the USA, don’t they?

segments.speaker: TIM
segments.en: They’re from Canada. They’re very popular over there. They’re going to perform a number of well-known pieces that will appeal to children as well as adults.

segments.speaker: JEAN
segments.en: That sounds good. My whole family are interested in music.

segments.speaker: TIM
segments.en: The next day, the 18th, there’s a performance by a ballet company called Eustatis. [[ ]]

segments.speaker: JEAN
segments.en: Sorry?

segments.speaker: TIM
segments.en: The name is spelt E-U-S-T-A-T-I-S. They appeared in last year’s festival, and went down very well. Again, their programme is designed for all ages.

segments.speaker: JEAN
segments.en: Good. I expect we’ll go to that. I hope there’s going to be a play during the festival, a comedy, ideally.

segments.speaker: TIM
segments.en: You’re in luck! On the 19th and 20th a local amateur group are performing one written by a member of group. It’s called Jemima. That’ll be on in the town hall. They’ve already performed it two or three times. I haven’t seen it myself, but the review [[ ]] in the local paper was very good.

segments.speaker: JEAN
segments.en: And is it suitable for children?

segments.speaker: TIM
segments.en: Yes, in fact it’s aimed more at children than at adults, so both performances are in the afternoon.

segments.speaker: JEAN
segments.en: And what about dance [[ ]] ? Will there by any performances?

segments.speaker: TIM
segments.en: Yes, also on the 20th, but in the evening. A professional company is putting on a show of modern pieces, with electronic music by young composers.

segments.speaker: JEAN
segments.en: Uh-huh.

segments.speaker: TIM
segments.en: The show is about how people communicate, or fail to communicate, with each other, so it’s got the rather strange name, Chat. [[ ]]

segments.speaker: JEAN
segments.en: I suppose that’s because that’s something we do both face to face and online.

segments.speaker: TIM
segments.en: That’s right. ———————-

segments.speaker: TIM
segments.en: Now there are also some workshops and other activities. They’ll all take place at least once every day, so everyone who wants to take part will have a chance.

segments.speaker: JEAN
segments.en: Good. We’re particularly interested in cookery – you don’t happen to have a cookery workshop, do you?

segments.speaker: TIM
segments.en: We certainly do. It’s going to focus on how to make food part of a healthy [[ ]] lifestyle, and it’ll show that even sweet things like cakes can contain much less sugar than they usually do.

segments.speaker: JEAN
segments.en: That might be worth going to. We’re trying to encourage our children to cook.

segments.speaker: TIM
segments.en: Another workshop is just for children, and that’s on creating posters [[ ]] to reflect the history of the town. The aim is to make children aware of how both the town and people’s lives have changed over the centuries. The results will be exhibited in the community centre. Then the other workshop is in toy-making, and that’s for adults only.

segments.speaker: JEAN
segments.en: Oh, why’s that?

segments.speaker: TIM
segments.en: Because it involves carpentry – participants will be making toys out of wood [[ ]] , so there’ll be a lot of sharp chisels and other tools around.

segments.speaker: JEAN
segments.en: It makes sense to keep children away from it.

segments.speaker: TIM
segments.en: Exactly. Now let me tell you about some of the outdoor activities. There’ll be supervised wild swimming ...

segments.speaker: JEAN
segments.en: Wild swimming? What’s that?

segments.speaker: TIM
segments.en: It just means swimming in natural waters, rather than a swimming pool.

segments.speaker: JEAN
segments.en: Oh OK. In a lake [[ ]] , for instance.

segments.speaker: TIM
segments.en: Yes, there’s a beautiful one just outside the town, and that’ll be the venue for the swimming. There’ll be lifeguards on duty, so it’s suitable for all ages. And finally, there’ll be a walk in some nearby woods every day. The leader is an expert on insects [[ ]] . He’ll show some that live in the woods, and how important they are for the environment. So there are going to be all sorts of different things to do during the festival.

segments.speaker: JEAN
segments.en: There certainly are.

segments.speaker: TIM
segments.en: If you’d like to read about how the preparations for the festival are going, the festival organizer is keeping a blog [[ ]] . Just search online for the festival website, and you’ll find it.

segments.speaker: JEAN
segments.en: Well, thank you very much for all the information.

segments.speaker: TIM
segments.en: You’re welcome. Goodbye.

segments.speaker: JEAN
segments.en: Goodbye.
